headline: Linn Mercy Stirs as Other Fronts Fall Quiet
war_summary: Since the evening edition Linn Mercy stands alone as the live wire with three changes in the last two hours and seventeen on the day centered on Lathair, holding ten Colonial to one Warden with day losses near 3,680 Colonial and 6,528 Warden and both rates still accelerating. Stlican Shelf has gone quiet in the last two hours after five in six and thirty on the day about Thornhold, now five Warden to four Colonial. Weathered Expanse likewise shows none in two hours after seven in six and thirty-seven on the day about Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, still four Warden to five Colonial with day tolls about 13,285 Colonial and 16,469 Warden quickening. Fisherman's Row counts forty-one on the day about Black Well and Fort Ember with six in six but none in two, now fully Colonial-held at nine to none. Mooring County, Godcrofts, Farranac Coast and Stonecradle report no changes in two hours, while Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line still show no flips despite severe and accelerating day losses.
